# kreuzberg v4.9.9 - Table of Contents

> High-performance document intelligence library with OCR support

## Pages

- [Elixir](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Kreuzberg](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.md): High-performance document extraction for Elixir.
- [Kreuzberg.Application](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Application.md): OTP Application callback for Kreuzberg.
- [Kreuzberg.ArchiveEntry](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ArchiveEntry.md): Structure representing an entry extracted from an archive file.
- [Kreuzberg.AsyncAPI](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.AsyncAPI.md): Asynchronous extraction operations using Elixir Tasks.
- [Kreuzberg.BatchAPI](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.BatchAPI.md): Batch extraction operations for processing multiple documents efficiently.
- [Kreuzberg.BibtexMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.BibtexMetadata.md): BibTeX bibliography metadata.
- [Kreuzberg.BoundingBox](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.BoundingBox.md): Bounding box coordinates for element positioning in documents.
- [Kreuzberg.CacheAPI](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CacheAPI.md): Cache management operations for the Kreuzberg extraction library.
- [Kreuzberg.Chunk](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Chunk.md): Structure representing a text chunk with embedding for semantic search.
- [Kreuzberg.ChunkMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ChunkMetadata.md): Metadata for a text chunk, tracking byte positions, indices, and page range.
- [Kreuzberg.CitationMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CitationMetadata.md): Citation file metadata (RIS, PubMed, EndNote).
- [Kreuzberg.CodeChunk](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeChunk.md): Code chunk with source span and optional parent context.
- [Kreuzberg.CodeChunkContext](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeChunkContext.md): Context for a code chunk (parent scope information).
- [Kreuzberg.CodeCommentInfo](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeCommentInfo.md): Comment information.
- [Kreuzberg.CodeDiagnostic](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeDiagnostic.md): Parse diagnostic (error or warning from tree-sitter).
- [Kreuzberg.CodeDocSection](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeDocSection.md): Section within a docstring.
- [Kreuzberg.CodeDocstringInfo](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeDocstringInfo.md): Docstring information with parsed sections.
- [Kreuzberg.CodeExportInfo](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeExportInfo.md): Export statement information.
- [Kreuzberg.CodeFileMetrics](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeFileMetrics.md): File-level code metrics from tree-sitter analysis.
- [Kreuzberg.CodeImportInfo](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeImportInfo.md): Import statement information.
- [Kreuzberg.CodeProcessResult](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeProcessResult.md): Result of tree-sitter code processing.
- [Kreuzberg.CodeSpan](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeSpan.md): Byte and line/column span for a code element.
- [Kreuzberg.CodeStructureItem](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeStructureItem.md): Structural code element (function, class, method, etc.).
- [Kreuzberg.CodeSymbolInfo](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CodeSymbolInfo.md): Symbol definition information.
- [Kreuzberg.ContentLayer](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ContentLayer.md): Enumeration of content layers within a document.
- [Kreuzberg.ContributorRole](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ContributorRole.md): JATS contributor with role.
- [Kreuzberg.CsvMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.CsvMetadata.md): CSV/TSV file metadata.
- [Kreuzberg.DbfFieldInfo](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DbfFieldInfo.md): dBASE field information.
- [Kreuzberg.DbfMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DbfMetadata.md): dBASE (DBF) file metadata.
- [Kreuzberg.DjotAttributes](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DjotAttributes.md): Element attributes in Djot ({.class #id key="value"} syntax).
- [Kreuzberg.DjotContent](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DjotContent.md): Comprehensive Djot document structure with semantic preservation.
- [Kreuzberg.DjotFootnote](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DjotFootnote.md): Footnote in a Djot document.
- [Kreuzberg.DjotFormattedBlock](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DjotFormattedBlock.md): Block-level element in a Djot document (paragraph, heading, list, etc.).
- [Kreuzberg.DjotImage](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DjotImage.md): Image element in a Djot document.
- [Kreuzberg.DjotInlineElement](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DjotInlineElement.md): Inline element within a Djot block (text, emphasis, link, etc.).
- [Kreuzberg.DjotLink](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DjotLink.md): Link element in a Djot document.
- [Kreuzberg.DocumentNode](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DocumentNode.md): A single node in the document tree.
- [Kreuzberg.DocumentStructure](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DocumentStructure.md): Structured document representation with hierarchical node tree.
- [Kreuzberg.DocumentTextAnnotation](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.DocumentTextAnnotation.md): Inline text annotation with byte-range formatting and links.
- [Kreuzberg.Element](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Element.md): Semantic element extracted from a document.
- [Kreuzberg.ElementMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ElementMetadata.md): Metadata for a semantic element extracted from a document.
- [Kreuzberg.ElementType](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ElementType.md): Enumeration of semantic element types in a document.
- [Kreuzberg.EmbeddingConfig](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.EmbeddingConfig.md): Configuration for standalone text embedding generation.

- [Kreuzberg.EpubMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.EpubMetadata.md): EPUB metadata (Dublin Core extensions).
- [Kreuzberg.ErrorMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ErrorMetadata.md): Error metadata when extraction partially failed.
- [Kreuzberg.ExtractionConfig](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ExtractionConfig.md): Configuration structure for document extraction operations.
- [Kreuzberg.ExtractionResult](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ExtractionResult.md): Structure representing the result of a document extraction operation.
- [Kreuzberg.FictionBookMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.FictionBookMetadata.md): FictionBook (FB2) metadata.
- [Kreuzberg.Helpers](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Helpers.md): Shared helper functions for Kreuzberg extraction modules.
- [Kreuzberg.HierarchicalBlock](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.HierarchicalBlock.md): A hierarchical block within a page, representing heading-level structure.
- [Kreuzberg.Image](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Image.md): Structure representing an extracted image from a document.
- [Kreuzberg.ImagePreprocessingMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ImagePreprocessingMetadata.md): Metadata about image preprocessing applied before OCR.
- [Kreuzberg.JatsMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.JatsMetadata.md): JATS (Journal Article Tag Suite) metadata.
- [Kreuzberg.Keyword](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Keyword.md): Structure representing an extracted keyword with score and algorithm info.
- [Kreuzberg.KeywordAlgorithm](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.KeywordAlgorithm.md): Enumeration of keyword extraction algorithms.
- [Kreuzberg.LayoutRegion](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.LayoutRegion.md): A detected layout region on a page.
- [Kreuzberg.LegacyAPI](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.LegacyAPI.md): Legacy API functions using deprecated patterns.
- [Kreuzberg.Metadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Metadata.md): Structure representing document metadata extracted from files.
- [Kreuzberg.OcrBoundingGeometry](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.OcrBoundingGeometry.md): Bounding geometry for OCR-extracted text elements.
- [Kreuzberg.OcrConfidence](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.OcrConfidence.md): Confidence scores for OCR text detection and recognition.
- [Kreuzberg.OcrElement](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.OcrElement.md): OCR-extracted text element with detailed positioning and confidence information.
- [Kreuzberg.OcrElementLevel](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.OcrElementLevel.md): Enumeration of OCR element hierarchical levels.
- [Kreuzberg.OcrRotation](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.OcrRotation.md): Rotation information for OCR-detected text.
- [Kreuzberg.OutputFormat](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.OutputFormat.md): Enumeration of output content formats.
- [Kreuzberg.Page](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Page.md): Structure representing a single page extracted from a multi-page document.
- [Kreuzberg.PageBoundary](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.PageBoundary.md): Byte offset boundary for a page.
- [Kreuzberg.PageHierarchy](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.PageHierarchy.md): Hierarchy information for a page, containing heading-level blocks.
- [Kreuzberg.PageInfo](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.PageInfo.md): Metadata for an individual page/slide/sheet.
- [Kreuzberg.PageStructure](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.PageStructure.md): Page structure information for a document.
- [Kreuzberg.PageUnitType](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.PageUnitType.md): Enumeration of page unit types in documents.
- [Kreuzberg.PdfAnnotation](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.PdfAnnotation.md): Structure representing a PDF annotation extracted from a document page.
- [Kreuzberg.PdfAnnotationType](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.PdfAnnotationType.md): Enumeration of PDF annotation types.
- [Kreuzberg.Plugin](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Plugin.md): Public Plugin API facade for registering and managing Kreuzberg plugins.
- [Kreuzberg.Plugin.OcrBackend](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Plugin.OcrBackend.md): Behaviour module for OCR backends in the Kreuzberg plugin system.
- [Kreuzberg.Plugin.PostProcessor](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Plugin.PostProcessor.md): Behaviour module for post-processor plugins in the Kreuzberg plugin system.
- [Kreuzberg.Plugin.Registry](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Plugin.Registry.md): GenServer for managing Kreuzberg plugins.
- [Kreuzberg.Plugin.Supervisor](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Plugin.Supervisor.md): OTP Supervisor for the Kreuzberg plugin system.
- [Kreuzberg.Plugin.Validator](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Plugin.Validator.md): Behaviour module for Kreuzberg document extraction validators.
- [Kreuzberg.ProcessingWarning](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ProcessingWarning.md): Structure representing a warning generated during document processing.
- [Kreuzberg.PstMetadata](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.PstMetadata.md): Outlook PST archive metadata.
- [Kreuzberg.RelationshipKind](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.RelationshipKind.md): Enumeration of relationship kinds between document elements.
- [Kreuzberg.ResultFormat](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.ResultFormat.md): Enumeration of result structure formats.
- [Kreuzberg.Table](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Table.md): Structure representing an extracted table from a document.
- [Kreuzberg.TreeSitterConfig](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.TreeSitterConfig.md): Tree-sitter configuration for code parsing.
- [Kreuzberg.TreeSitterProcessConfig](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.TreeSitterProcessConfig.md): Tree-sitter process configuration for code extraction.
- [Kreuzberg.Uri](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Uri.md): Structure representing a URI extracted from a document.
- [Kreuzberg.UriKind](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.UriKind.md): Enumeration of URI kinds.
- [Kreuzberg.UtilityAPI](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.UtilityAPI.md): Utility functions for Kreuzberg extraction operations.
- [Kreuzberg.Validators](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Validators.md): Configuration validators for Kreuzberg extraction options.
- [Kreuzberg.YearRange](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.YearRange.md): Year range for bibliographic metadata.

- Exceptions
  - [Kreuzberg.Error](https://kreuzberg.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzberg.Error.md): Exception module for Kreuzberg extraction errors.
